slides.title: What is the homework?

panels.heading: Update the plan
panels.support: The new 3HAG, 1HAG and QHAG. Any change to your Core Purpose, Core Values or BHAG. Each leader’s priorities. Each sprint lane’s steps. The Team View.

panels.heading: War Room and forecast
panels.support: War Room: add the differentiators and swim lanes. Finance enters the 12-month forecast in Metronome.

panels.heading: Team and A-Players
panels.support: Start the five actions from your Five Dysfunctions review. Act on the plan for everyone below A.

panels.heading: Prepare
panels.support: Read The Speed of Trust. Complete the quarterly prep survey.

notes: On the One Page Plan, the differentiators replace the key capabilities. Keep the Market Map, Core Customer and Attribution Framework current in the War Room.

Also: share the 3 key messages with your team the day after. Review the KFFM in every weekly leadership meeting. Keep running all company meetings through Metronome. Add the widget-based company metric, if defined.
If the Painted Picture wording was not finished in the room, finishing it is homework.
Add any scorecard review not done, with its date.
Give every item an owner and a date: what, owner, by when.

slides.title: Did we get what we came for?
slides.support: For each outcome: met, partly met or still open?

artwork.alt: A sticky note with the coach’s outcome for the session: Strategy mapped out. New 3HAG.

notes: Read back the outcomes the team agreed at the start of Day 1.
Ask for a show of hands on each one.
Still open is fine. Add each open outcome to the homework with an owner and a date.
The sticky shows the coach’s outcome for the session. Ask the team whether it was met, along with their own.
